race.comment: FIELDELO (3) is a promising galloper who resumes from a break and returns to the meeting that she won her maiden on debut two years ago. Has placed in Stakes grade since and while she has been off the scene for over a year due to injury, she's brilliantly won a couple of trials this season and looks ready to go. YUKAINA (5) showed early speed from an outside draw and held a forward position before fading to finish ninth, beaten 4.5 lengths, last start over 1100m at Bendigo. Will be handy in the run and should prove hard to run down. DELICATE LADY (1) held on well to finish third last time out over 1200m at Sale after leading for much of the way. Racing consistently and gets in nicely after the 4kg for a young rider who looks to have talent. SUGAR SCHNAPPS (8) went forward last start and proved too strong, getting home by 1.5 lengths over 1200m at Ballarat. Finds a tougher race but another big run will not surprise.
